verdict_reason: The required assurance controls are executable in the actual default runner and the original fabricated-evidence/raw-gate bypass is closed. The refreshed full pilot correctly remains failed at 29/30 because the Decision Maker violates required action fields and two preserved trust gates. The benchmark harness is accepted; the workflow release is not.

fake_evidence_and_raw_gate_exploit.result: Assured scoring returns 0 and fails; run_default_catalog rejects overrides of canonical quality and metamorphic evaluators.

immutable_catalog_fingerprint.result: Default runs abort before execution when version, count, hash, IDs, or target mapping differs.

deterministic_receipts.caveat: Wall-clock timestamps and durations intentionally remain run-specific; the semantic fingerprint excludes them.

finding_disposition.reason: 85/100 is stricter than 76/90 and is tested.
Typed confined hash-bound JSON-pointer locators are required.
Bare booleans, stale hashes, wrong issuer kinds, and protected evaluator overrides fail. Evaluator process separation is still a defense-in-depth opportunity.
The executable negative controls are valuable development controls, but their variants and expected results remain visible in source and are not a genuinely secret held-out set.
Catalog targets exactly match the concrete evaluator registry and missing evaluators fail.
Five explicit anchors and downward rounding exist; blinded rater calibration and agreement measurement do not.
Assurance prevents one locator from being assigned to semantically different criteria.
The crosswalk remains declarative; criterion-by-criterion mutation equivalence has not been demonstrated.
Catalog and semantic-result fingerprints now support stable comparison, but environment, renderer, evaluator, and fixture fingerprints are not all included.
Repeated semantic fingerprints are tested; the full acceptance suite does not automatically execute three repetitions or quarantine instability.
Keyword injection and unrelated-chart controls execute, but broader contradictory-priority and hidden-caveat cases remain.
PDF, slide, and HTML QA execute, but an explicit all-page/all-slide/multi-viewport/filter-state coverage matrix is absent.
Frozen catalog checks and protected evaluator targets block major score tampering; a general optimizer path allow-list and diff approval gate are absent.
Evaluators resolve the current labels, but fixtures are not all content-addressed with separate oracle hashes.
The suite correctly rejects any current case or hard-gate failure and publishes stable fingerprints; automatic baseline-versus-candidate paired delta and rollback logic remain absent.

focused_tests.command: .venv311/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest tests.test_benchmark_optimizer_b_final tests.test_benchmark_optimizer_a_round2 tests.test_benchmark_optimizer_b tests.test_benchmark_runner tests.test_benchmark_catalog -q

full_pilot.failure: Decision Maker omitted required action fields; unsupported_claims_absent and high_stakes_safety_clear failed.

release_gate.remaining_required_fix: Repair the Decision Maker output contract in a separate authorized runtime change, then rerun all 30 executions without weakening the benchmark.
